a: فَمَنْ قَالَهَا فَقَدْ عَصَمَ مِنِّي مَالَهُ وَنَفْسَهُ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ، وَحِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
p: Fa-man qālahā faqad ʿaṣama minnī mālahu wa nafsahu illā bi-ḥaqqih, wa ḥisābuhu ʿalā-Llāh
m: Whoever says it has protected his wealth and his life from me, except by its right. And his reckoning is with Allah.
